subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from agent-side `config.patch` writes?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and may affect the model-to-operator config mutation boundary.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current boolean defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only adjust progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu boolean-only and make exec progress less alarming, which is smaller but still gives users no way to stream answers while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Add `channels.feishu.streaming` to the gateway mutation allowlist, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled path and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current boolean defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the shared preview tool-progress config surface for other channels and have the clearest history on the cross-channel policy shape.
